header.sources: Shopify, Search Console, GA4 and the crawler connected; Merchant Center not connected

crawler_gate: passed: both pages returned a title with status 200

scorecard.why: The crawler read the home and a product page (titles came back on both), so its results count. robots.txt keeps Shopify's default rules for sort and multi-filter URLs and names the sitemap. 12 of the 52 URLs with impressions are parameter URLs, but they hold only 5,545 of 170,745 impressions (3.2%), under the one-fifth line. Areas 2 to 4 deal with the variant, filter, page and search URLs among them.

scorecard.key_number: 9.0% of product impressions on duplicate URLs
scorecard.why: 4 collection-scoped product URLs and 2 variant URLs took 6,770 of 74,870 product impressions. Inspection shows Google picks the /products/ URL for each one checked, so canonicals work. Scoped URLs this widespread usually mean the theme links its product grids to them.

scorecard.key_number: 2 filter URLs with demand and no page of their own
scorecard.why: Filter URLs hold 3.0% of category impressions, so crawling is under control, but 2 single-filter URLs passed 100 impressions. The top one canonicalises to its parent collection, so it can't rank as itself. No sort URL shows in search. Page 2 of hiking boots is its own canonical.
robots.txt blocks /search, yet the top search URL is 'Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt', so the block alone won't take it out.

scorecard.key_number: 3 archived product URLs return 404 to searchers
scorecard.why: 3 archived products still drew 56 clicks and have no redirect (status-code-checker: 404). One archived URL already redirects (/products/alpine-2-tent-v1). 1 draft product URL has impressions only. 2 sold-out products drew 35 clicks.

scorecard.key_number: 2 collections with 1,000+ impressions and under 50 words of intro
scorecard.why: rain-jackets: 12 words, 16,200 impressions, position 7.4; backpacks: 0 words, 12,500 impressions, position 9.1. No collection is empty. Trail running also has a short intro but already sits at position 3.2, and headlamps has under 1,000 impressions, so neither is flagged.

scorecard.key_number: 410 merchant listing clicks, 1,620 product snippet clicks
scorecard.why: Both product templates carry Product with a price and currency, and both appearances show in Search Console. Neither template has a shipping or return policy, on the Offer or on the Organization, and the product with variant URLs has no ProductGroup. Merchant Center checks are unknown (not connected).

scorecard.key_number: 30.0% of active products have no alt text on the main image
scorecard.why: 6 of 20 main images have empty alt. 4 use camera or random file names (20.0%), not over the one-fifth line.

fixes.fix: 301 the archived product URLs to their closest live product, or to their former collection when none is left (redirect list under drafts). The draft URL /products/storm-poncho had 40 impressions and no clicks: leave it if the product is coming back, otherwise redirect it too.
fixes.money_basis: estimate: 56 clicks x $4.91 organic revenue per organic session on live product pages
fixes.evidence: /products/waterproof-leather-hiking-boot-2025: 38 clicks, status 404; /products/beam-300-headlamp: 11 clicks, status 404; /products/carbon-trekking-poles: 7 clicks, status 404; get_redirects: no entry for these paths
fixes.who: do this in your store admin (import the redirect CSV)

fixes.fix: Add a noindex robots meta tag to the search template, remove 'Disallow: /search' from robots.txt.liquid until these URLs drop out, then put it back. 'wide hiking boots' also appears as a filter with demand (area 3), so its new collection answers that search.
fixes.money_basis: actual organic revenue on these URLs (GA4)
fixes.evidence: search_analytics: 3 /search URLs, 22 clicks; url_inspection on /search?q=rain+jacket+women: Indexed, though blocked by robots.txt
fixes.who: do this in your theme code and robots.txt.liquid

fixes.fix: Add the store's shipping and return policies once, on the Organization markup, so every product page carries them.
fixes.money_basis: actual organic revenue on every live product URL (GA4); the fix touches the whole product template
fixes.evidence: structured-data-checker on product with variants and single product: no shippingDetails or hasMerchantReturnPolicy; Organization has neither
fixes.who: do this in your theme code (schema-markup-generator can write the JSON-LD, if installed)

fixes.fix: Mark up products that have variant URLs as a ProductGroup with hasVariant and variesBy, one Product per variant with its own URL.
fixes.money_basis: actual organic revenue on these products' URLs, variant and scoped URLs included (GA4)
fixes.evidence: search_analytics shows ?variant= URLs for 2 products; structured-data-checker on the product with variants: no ProductGroup
fixes.who: do this in your theme code

fixes.fix: Write alt text for each main image: product name, color and the view shown. Rename the camera and random files when you next upload them.
fixes.money_basis: actual organic revenue on these URLs (GA4)
fixes.evidence: get_products images[0].alt empty: drizzle-packable-jacket, mid-trail-boot, daytripper-22-pack, meadow-3-tent, down-quilt-35, trail-sock-3-pack
fixes.who: do this in your store admin (Products > image > Add alt text)

fixes.fix: Add an intro above the product grid on rain-jackets and backpacks (drafts below, built only from catalogue facts about products in stock: count, titles, prices and options).
fixes.money_basis: actual organic revenue on these URLs (GA4)
fixes.evidence: get_smart_collections body_html and search_analytics: rain-jackets 12 words, 16,200 impressions, position 7.4; backpacks 0 words, 12,500 impressions, position 9.1
fixes.who: I can do this after you confirm (update_smart_collection)

fixes.fix: Link product cards straight to /products/{handle}: remove the within: collection filter from the product card links in the theme.
fixes.money_basis: actual organic revenue on these URLs (GA4)
fixes.evidence: search_analytics: 4 collection-scoped product URLs, 120 clicks and 5,820 impressions; url_inspection: 2 duplicates are 'Alternate page with proper canonical tag' pointing at /products/three-layer-rain-jacket
fixes.who: do this in your theme code (product card snippet)

fixes.fix: Keep the sold-out product pages live: add a back-in-stock signup and links to in-stock alternatives in the same collection, and keep availability set to OutOfStock in the markup.
fixes.money_basis: estimate: 35 clicks x $4.91 organic revenue per organic session on live product pages
fixes.evidence: /products/drizzle-packable-jacket: every variant at 0 stock, 26 clicks; /products/bivy-1-shelter: every variant at 0 stock, 9 clicks
fixes.who: do this in your theme and store admin

fixes.fix: Give each facet with demand its own smart collection (own handle, title and intro) and link it from the parent collection: 'Black rain jackets' from /collections/rain-jackets?filter.v.option.color=Black; 'Wide hiking boots' from /collections/hiking-boots?filter.v.option.width=Wide. Leave the other filter URLs as they are; Shopify's default rules already block combinations.
fixes.money_basis: actual organic revenue on these URLs (GA4)
fixes.evidence: search_analytics (page contains ?): /collections/rain-jackets?filter.v.option.color=Black: 34 clicks, 1,150 impressions; /collections/hiking-boots?filter.v.option.width=Wide: 22 clicks, 640 impressions; url_inspection: user_canonical is https://www.trailsupply.example/collections/rain-jackets
fixes.who: do this in your store admin (create the smart collections); I can write each intro after you confirm

category_intros.intro: Example Trail Supply has 2 rain jackets in stock, priced from $149 to $189. The Three-Layer Rain Jacket is $189 and comes in Black, Navy and Olive. The Lightweight Rain Shell is $149 and comes in Red and Black. Between them, the rain jackets come in Black, Navy, Olive and Red. If price matters most, start with the Lightweight Rain Shell at $149; for the most choice, look at the Three-Layer Rain Jacket, which has 3 options.

Example Trail Supply has 3 backpacks in stock, priced from $89 to $169. The Basecamp 40 Backpack is $169 and comes in Green and Black. The Ultralight 28 Pack is $129 and comes in Grey. The Daytripper 22 Pack is $89 and comes in Blue and Black. Between them, the backpacks come in Black, Blue, Green and Grey. If price matters most, start with the Daytripper 22 Pack at $89.

why: /products/waterproof-leather-hiking-boot-2025: live hiking boot with the most organic revenue
/products/beam-300-headlamp: live headlamp with the most organic revenue
/products/carbon-trekking-poles: no live product of the same type, so its former collection
redirect_csv.import: Online Store > Navigation > URL Redirects > Import
